subject: URGENT: Your account will be suspended in 24 hours
summary: Email claims unusual activity and threatens account suspension in 24 hours unless the reader verifies identity through a link.
reason: Looks like phishing: the sender domain is a lookalike (northwind-bank-verify.example), the greeting is generic, and it pressures the reader to click a link to avoid suspension.
body_text:
Dear Customer,

We detected unusual activity. Your account will be SUSPENDED in 24 hours unless you verify your identity at http://northwind-bank-verify.example/login immediately.

Northwind Security
